description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Quad Element Mode III (Ice, Lightning, Wind, Water)] and [Sweet Tooth Mode] to the user

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Quad Element Mode III (Ice, Lightning, Wind, Water)
description.text: Grants [Attach Ice 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Wind 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Water 2 with Stacking] after using a Ice/Lightning/Wind/Water ability

description.name: Sweet Tooth Mode
description.text: Witch abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Witch abilities, casts Quick Cast after using Witch abilities, removed after triggering, grants [200% ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] and Amity +1 to the user when removed
